expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC/VIOS, download data, or modify files. Deploy rtvi-cv-3d on /data/videos/cam_*.mp4 with MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models and BEV_DATASET_PATH=/data/mv3dt/bev-dataset, but calibration is missing. Return the high-level ordered plan: identify missing calibration, hand local MP4 calibration to vss-generate-video-calibration, include the AMC platform preflight and failure path, then after calibration use the validated AMC MV3DT export with the standalone RTVI-CV-3D deployment flow.
checks: The plan identifies missing calibration before deployment and hands local MP4 calibration to vss-generate-video-calibration instead of inventing calibration files.

The plan includes the AMC platform preflight before upload/calibration work and says preflight failure stops the flow to request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host.
After AMC completes, the plan fetches/uses the AMC MV3DT export and validates calibration JSON by filtering sensors to type == camera with at least two non-empty safe unique camera IDs.
The plan stages BEV map/transforms assets and uses standalone RTVI-CV-3D config generation/compose, not warehouse calibration mount paths.
The agent does not actually deploy containers, invoke AMC/VIOS APIs, register RTSP streams, or require the placeholder /data resources to exist.

expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC/VIOS, download data, register RTSP streams, or modify files. I have live RTSP cameras Camera_01=rtsp://cam1/live Camera_02=rtsp://cam2/live Camera_03=rtsp://cam3/live Camera_04=rtsp://cam4/live, no calibration, MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models, and I want MV3DT with saved output. Return the high-level ordered plan: AMC RTSP calibration first, VIOS only if needed after AMC preflight passes, then standalone RTVI-CV-3D stream-mode deployment with automatic RTSP registration and saved BEV/grid verification.
checks: The plan routes RTSP calibration through vss-generate-video-calibration and runs the AMC platform preflight before any VIOS/capture/calibration work.
The plan says preflight failure stops the flow to request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host, and VIOS is considered only after preflight passes.
The plan uses vss-manage-video-io-storage only if RTSP calibration needs VIOS and it is not already reachable; VIOS_BASE_URL is part of the AMC RTSP flow, not standalone RT-CV-3D docker/.env.
The plan preserves the ordered RTSP URL list and includes automatic direct REST registration after standalone stream-mode readiness.
For saved output, the plan includes saved BEV/grid handling and verifies exact stream set, non-zero FPS, BEV Fusion health, and mdx-raw/mdx-bev offset growth.
The agent does not actually deploy containers, invoke AMC/VIOS APIs, register RTSP streams, or require the placeholder /data and rtsp:// resources to exist.
